pkgmetadata.longdescription: pgloader loads data into PostgreSQL using COPY. This overlay package uses the official pgloader-bundle tarball (vendored Common Lisp libraries) and dumps a binary with SBCL, so the GURU Common Lisp stack is not required. MySQL/MariaDB is handled by qmynd (Lisp protocol), not libmysqlclient. A named-readtables patch is included for SBCL 2.6.5 and later.
